units.CD9104-luiza-2: This unit covers the Yangala health zone in the south of Luiza territory (Kasaï-Central), between Luiza and the Angolan border area. Luiza territory was badly hit by the Kamuina Nsapu insurgency in 2017, but the militias were defeated by FARDC operations and most remaining fighters surrendered in 2019; no armed group is known to hold territory in the area as of 2026. The main town and the larger villages fall under the PNC and customary chiefs, with FARDC and ANR present in the territory; residual insecurity is banditry and occasional local militia incidents. Live web research was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted, fetch blocked), so the assessment relies on background knowledge and default state presence, with limited confidence.
units.CD9104-luiza-1: Luiza territory (Luiza, Masuika and Luambo secteurs in this unit) was one of the epicentres of the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency, with heavy militia and FARDC violence around Luiza town in 2017. The militias were dispersed and largely surrendered by 2018, and no armed group has been reported holding territory here since. Luiza town is state-held with PNC, ANR and a FARDC detachment; rural secteurs rely on sparse PNC posts and customary chiefs. Live web research was unavailable in this run, so the assessment relies on background knowledge and default state presence, with low-to-medium confidence.
